title: Hintz Manor - Clue-Style Mystery & Evidence Engine
description: Transforms tactical map movement and turns into an automated Clue-style murder mystery engine with per-turn travel history, sightlines, semi-autonomous cascading NPC pathing, OpenVTT map importer, 13 NPC roster, Motive & Knowledge grids, vertical sidebar button dock, Beaver's System Interface support, and interactive evidence deduction UI.
